newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aerospatiale head slams DASA choice.
newsitem.headline: Aerospatiale head slams DASA choice.

text.p: The chairman of France's Ste Nationale Industrielle Aerospatiale on Tuesday said he was dismayed at German firm DASA's decision to team up with Lagardere for Thomson-CSF.
Yves Michot said in an interview in daily Les Echos that an alliance of Lagardere, DASA and British Aerospace against Aerospatiale was "signing the death warrant of Airbus".
The French government is selling a 58 percent stake in defence electronics group Thomson-CSF and final bids have been made by groups led by Lagardere and Alcatel Alsthom.

"It would have been normal that, like Aerospatiale, DASA would have awaited the choice of the French government on the privatisation and afterwards associate itself with the winner," Yves Michot told business newspaper.
"That's to say that DASA awaits the outcome of a privatisation of a French company and does not take a position in a Franco-French debate," he added.
State-owned Aerospatiale has been banned by the government from taking a position in the privatisation but the group favours the offer made by Alcatel and Dassault Industries.
Aerospatiale itself is in merger talks with Dassault Aviation.
"To see our ally of thirty years intervene in a dossier where we can ourselves not participate, leads us to a number of questions," he added.

Aerospatiale and Daimler-Benz Aerospace (DASA) are both partners in the Airbus Industrie European civil plane making consortium. Other Airbus partner British Aerospace Plc has also concluded a deal with Lagardere. Spain's CASA, the fourth Airbus partner, has not taken a position.
Aerospatiale and DASA are also allied in Eurocopter and Euromissiles which makes mainly the HOT 3 missile.
Michot said the activities of Euromissiles were now stopped in their tracks due to the missiles deal of DASA with Lagardere.

"It should not be the case that around the privatisation of Thomson-CSF we will see a weakening of the French aerospace sector," Michot said. "An alliance against Aerospatiale, that's signing Airbus's death warrant".
Alcatel chairman Serge Tchuruk and Dassault head Serge Dassault will host a news conference later on Tuesday on their joint bid for the Thomson-CSF stake.
